title: Stock Price Alerts (Observer)
summary: A ticker notifies subscribed listeners on price changes. Edge-triggered threshold alerts, unsubscribe handles, and failure isolation.
hints: Ticker: remember the last price per symbol and only notify when it **changes**.
Notify over a **snapshot** of listeners (`CopyOnWriteArrayList`, or copy the slice) so a listener can unsubscribe itself mid-notification.
Wrap each listener call: catch `RuntimeException` in Java, `defer recover()` in Go, `except Exception` in Python.
Alert: keep a `boolean triggered`. Fire when the condition becomes true **and** `!triggered`. Reset when the condition is false again. Ignore other symbols.
